static_headroom.screen: static headroom: skip a bug whose omission is plain from the pre-fix source alone
static_headroom.judgment: The omission is plain from the planted source alone. A reader of getPageviewStats.ts sees relationalQuery destructure a timezone it never uses, next to a ClickHouse branch that passes the same value to the same helper.
reasons: Line 17 of the pinned file, in relationalQuery, destructures `const { timezone = 'utc', unit = 'day' } = filters;`.

The mutation changes line 28 from `getDateSQL('website_event.created_at', unit, timezone)` to `getDateSQL('website_event.created_at', unit)`. That call was the only use of `timezone` in relationalQuery, so after the mutation the destructured `timezone` is unused.
clickhouseQuery in the same file still calls `getDateSQL('website_event.created_at', unit, timezone)` on lines 66 and 86; the mutation leaves both calls unchanged.

leak_screen.reason: The case already fails the static-headroom screen, so it cannot serve as a log-tool case whatever its issue text and responses reveal.

uc1_use: Harness pilot only, published as "harness pilot; bug fails the static-headroom screen; not a UC1 result". If the fallback is chosen on Oct 18, 2026, it runs as a low-headroom contrast, never as a tool-effect illustration.
